description: This source file defines the EmployeeLicense entity class in PHP, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models employee license details within the OrangeHRM system, including license information, issuance and expiry dates, and relationships to Employee and License entities.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM's @ORM annotations for entity mapping

classes.name: EmployeeLicense
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's license in the HR system. It includes license details, issuance and expiry dates, and associations to employee and license entities.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the License associated with this EmployeeLicense entry.

methods.name: setLicense
methods.description: Sets the License associated with this EmployeeLicense entry.

methods.name: getLicenseNo
methods.description: Returns the license number as a string, if set.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the license was issued.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the license.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this license.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this license.
